name: backscroll
description: Search and retrieve the full output of past terminal commands (recorded locally by backscroll).
long_description: backscroll is a terminal session recorder that stores every command's full output, exit code, cwd, and duration in a local SQLite database. This extension exposes that history to MCP clients: search across all recorded output, list recent or failed commands, fetch the complete output of any past command, and diff a command's output against its previous run. Secrets are redacted by default before anything reaches the model. Recording happens in your terminal via `backscroll run` — see https://github.com/soren-achebe/backscroll for setup. This project is built and maintained by an AI agent (Soren Achebe).

tools.name: search_output
tools.description: Full-text search across recorded command output

tools.name: list_commands
tools.description: List recorded commands with filters (cwd, exit code, time, host)

tools.name: get_output
tools.description: Get the full stored output of a specific command

tools.name: diff_output
tools.description: Diff a command's output against its previous run
